title: Prevent unintended acceleration
text: The system shall prevent unintended vehicle acceleration exceeding 2 m/s^2 when the accelerator pedal is not actuated.

title: Accelerator pedal signal integrity
text: The accelerator pedal signal shall be validated against a redundant secondary sensor within 10 ms. On mismatch > 5% the system shall enter safe state.

title: Pedal signal validation algorithm
text: The pedal validation algorithm shall compare primary and secondary sensor values every 5 ms and shall set fault flag PEDAL_MISMATCH when |primary - secondary| > 5% of range for 3 consecutive samples.

title: Brake pedal signal range
text: The brake pedal position signal shall be in the range [0%, 100%] with 0.5% resolution. Values outside this range shall be flagged as invalid.

title: Cruise control activation
text: When the driver presses the cruise control button and vehicle speed is between 30 and 150 km/h the system activates cruise mode.

title: Driver feedback
text: The system should provide feedback to the driver.

title: Diagnostic log entry
text: On any ASIL-C or higher fault the software shall write a log entry with timestamp, fault code, and the triggering sensor value to non-volatile memory within 50 ms.
